Title: GraphQL API and JWT authentication

Summary:
Offer a GraphQL API (Graphene) alongside REST endpoints, with JWT auth for clients.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add GraphQL endpoint exposing Activities, Members, Events, and Attendance.
- JWT authentication for GraphQL mutations requiring login.
- Add GraphiQL playground for development.

Implementation notes:
- This is optional; provide a migration path from REST to GraphQL for new features.
